usage: xo vet [--json] [dirs or .xo files...]

Advisory checks (never errors, exit 0): the warnings of check, unused
declared effects (XO0703), x ?? [].f() precedence traps (XO0207), every
.ignore_err reason (XO0208), use go packages and functions that perform
go per module (XO1103), dbg(...) left in code (XO0901), tls.Verify.None
(XO0902). Default: .

A .xo file vets its directory and reports that file's findings. A
directory of std (std, std/native, std/native/llrt) or a file in one is
checked as std, its modules together.

A directory covers the directories below it, so DIR/... is DIR (decision
0210); a DIR/... with no .xo file at or below DIR is an error.
